compatibility_profiles.name: windows-x86-vault-fail-closed
compatibility_profiles.reason: The maintained bcrypt/cryptography security stack has no reviewed Windows x86 build chain in this repository. Known-vulnerable fallback releases are excluded; packaged vault and encrypted OpenSSH-key commands must report their backends unavailable and fail closed. This artifact is not Windows XP readiness evidence.

python_packages.name: pip
python_packages.purpose: Pinned installer front-end for release jobs.

python_packages.name: maturin
python_packages.purpose: Pinned PEP 517 backend for the Windows ARM64 cryptography source build.

python_packages.name: cffi
python_packages.purpose: Pinned cryptography build/runtime bridge for the Windows ARM64 source build and packaged vault.

python_packages.name: pycparser
python_packages.purpose: Pinned transitive cffi parser dependency used by release security builds.

python_packages.name: PyQt6
python_packages.purpose: Pinned desktop GUI dependency for native GUI bundles, including Windows x64 and ARM64 wheels.

python_packages.name: PyQt6-Qt6
python_packages.purpose: Pinned Qt runtime wheel used by PyQt6 native GUI bundles.

python_packages.name: bcrypt
python_packages.purpose: Pinned OpenSSH private-key encryption KDF dependency used by cryptography-backed in-process key generation.

python_packages.name: cryptography
python_packages.purpose: Pinned modern vault encryption dependency with the current security fixes. Windows x64 uses the upstream wheel; Windows ARM64 builds this version from source against the pinned ARM64 OpenSSL toolchain.

python_packages.name: truststore
python_packages.purpose: Pinned native certificate-store integration used by the security extra.

windows.name: openssl
windows.purpose: Architecture-correct OpenSSL used only for the cryptography 50 Windows ARM64 source build; weak cipher features remain disabled.

linux.name: appimagetool
linux.verification: Every downloaded or locally supplied appimagetool binary must match the architecture-specific SHA-256 before execution.

embedded_runtime.verification: Every AppImage build must pass the reviewed type-2 runtime to appimagetool with --runtime-file after verifying the architecture-specific SHA-256.
